notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q25173_titanic.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/scenekit.py, tools/abyss.py) with AI assistance. Bow section (~143 m) upright, ploughed into a mud ridge: funnels gone (torn stubs), foremast fallen over the bridge, officers' quarters roof partly fallen in (Captain Smith's bathtub in view), holes where the wooden decks rotted away, decks sagging and torn plates at the break. Stern section (~109 m) collapsed about 600 m to the south, facing the opposite way, with its propellers and plates standing up around it; debris field with five boilers, coal, funnel pieces and fallen cranes. Riveted steel textures, the black paint gone brown, thousands of rusticles and rust runs, baked ambient occlusion. In the debris field: pairs of shoes, rows of White Star plates, cups, corked bottles, bench ends, copper pots, a safe, an engine telegraph and suitcases. Repeated things are stored once with instancing (EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing); positions are 16-bit (KHR_mesh_quantization). model_built.glb: the ship as she sailed (funnels, masts, shrouds and aerial, lifeboats, glass dome), planked decks, clean plating, baked ambient occlusion. The wreck lies in its own sediment (node «sediment»: drifts against the hull and every piece of debris, the ridges the bow ploughed up), which Offlined paints with the seabed colour. Headings are approximate (bow roughly north). No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
